name: L&I Contractor License - Principal Data
description: Addendum to L&I Contractor License Data - General. Principles are owners associated with a registered license number.

columns.name: BusinessName
columns.description: The registered name in which the contractor is doing business as.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseNumber
columns.description: The Contractor License Number is the unique combination of letters, numbers and symbols that are specific and unique to a contractor. This license number is generated by L&I.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCode
columns.description: An abbreviation which identifies the Contractor License Type.

columns.name: ContractorLicenseTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: Identification of the type of contractor license.

columns.name: BusinessTypeCode
columns.description: Code which identifies the business structure.

columns.name: BusinessTypeCodeDesc
columns.description: The legal business structure of which a business is registered as.

columns.name: UBI
columns.description: Unified Business Identifier (UBI) is a nine digit number that registers you with several state agencies and allows you to do business in Washington State.

columns.name: PrincipalName
columns.description: The names of the owner, member, partner or corporate officer.

columns.name: StartDate
columns.description: The date the principal was added to the contractor registration.

columns.name: EndDate
columns.description: The date the principal was removed from the contractor registration.
